The '''Sontor system''' was located within the [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Sontor Skipper]]''.<ref name="Planets">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Sontor system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square K-19.<ref name="TEA" />
